description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class for REST API endpoints in the OrangeHRM project. It provides the structure for handling different HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), validation, and error handling, serving as a base class to be extended by specific REST controllers.

classes.name: AbstractRestController
classes.description: An abstract base class for REST API controllers providing method stubs for handling HTTP requests and validation rules, including comprehensive error handling logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the request, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle GET requests.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle POST requests.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle PUT requests.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to handle DELETE requests.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize GET request validation rules.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize POST request validation rules.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize PUT request validation rules.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize DELETE request validation rules.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Determines which validation rules to apply based on the HTTP method.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method that processes incoming HTTP requests, manages validation, invokes abstract request handlers, and handles exceptions, returning an HttpResponse.
